sana (pm): quick q — could the console surface an explicit 'activation semantics' field for runtime flags? i.e. immediate vs scheduled vs staged cohorts
kevin (eng): yes, we have scheduled via activation_time but staged cohorts is missing today
lia (infra): staged cohorts is important for quota-sensitive flags — we should chunk by % and ramp with telemetry gates
andre (platform): agreed. UX needs to show current cohort, next cohort ETA, and rollback action inline :eyes:
sana (pm): +1. product needs to know if a flag is 'safe-to-rollback' or 'migration-only' too
kevin (eng): api sketch: 
```
PATCH /runtime-configs/:id
{
  "activation": "staged",    // immediate | scheduled | staged
  "activation_time": "2026-06-01T14:00:00Z",
  "staged_policy": {
    "batches": [{"pct":10, "wait_secs":3600}, {"pct":50, "wait_secs":7200}],
    "telemetry_gate": "latency_regression_v2"
  }
}
```
kevin (eng): proposal includes telemetry_gate id so rollout pauses on regression automatically
lia (infra): need idempotency guarantees. if PATCH is retried we must not create duplicate background jobs. use etag or operation-id
andre (platform): API should return a rollout_id for any staged activation and provide endpoints to inspect cohort state
sana (pm): console copy should show "next cohort in 35m" and a clear abort button. also show which telemetry gate last evaluated
kevin (eng): ops question — when staged_policy references telemetry_gate, who owns gate definitions? eval team? we need clear contract
lia (infra): telemetry gate will be a simple boolean API: GET /gates/:id/status?since=... -> {"ok":true,"last_eval":"...","reason":""}
andre (platform): implementer note: runtime should accept both active flag value and rollout metadata so servers can short-circuit cohort eval locally
sana (pm): can we show a simulated rollout in console (dry-run) that projects token/quota impact per cohort? helps sales/customer-ops
kevin (eng): we can approximate using historical request distribution, but add big caveat: estimates only
lia (infra): on etags — we should enforce If-Match header on updates; if mismatch return 412 with current config in body
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime-worker-v3 rolling update at 2026-05-10T03:00:00Z
andre (platform): final checklist from eng: API proto, etag handling, rollout_id in response, background scheduler metrics, dry-run endpoint
sana (pm): i'll add acceptance criteria to the ticket: console UI states, abort UX, dry-run, rollout audit trail, telemetry gate link
kevin (eng): ok i'm pairing with lia tomorrow to draft API RFC. will mock command-line examples and curl snippets
sana (pm): thanks — one more: include 'safety_window' field (e.g. business hours only) — legal wants changes only in maintenance windows
lia (infra): can enforce safety_window at scheduler level, +1. also add admin override boolean for emergency
andre (platform): filing followups: permissions matrix for who can start staged rollouts, and retention for rollout audit logs
sana (pm): perfect. tagging @kevin @lia for RFC. closing for now :thumbsup:
